​ Absolute nightmare. Booked a unit for my family, including elderly relatives. They checked in at 11 PM and walked in on strangers sitting on the sofa—the host double-booked the listing. Leaving elderly guests stranded at midnight is unacceptable and a severe safety failure. Airbnb support offered zero real help beyond a basic refund and a useless 20% credit. Unsafe host management and terrible customer support. Avoid.

I attempted to make a reservation for my family because my AC got cut off and they flagged my reservation as a possibly trying to throw a party. I made an appeal which got denied and then tried to rebook and called Airbnb to explain my situation. the location I was trying to book was perfect for my family because it was close to my kids school. then they suspended my account due to making multiple requests. my family is now sitting in a 90° house in the middle of Arizona.
Airbnb's policy in India is terrible. They only care about business; they don't make decisions in the interest of the hosts.
